title: Moonlit Breakwater: The Cartographer's Harbor Charter
premise: In a drowned port exposed at the edge of the lunar tide, the cartographer must chart hidden passages before nightfall using a living contour chart.
ending: Recover the Harbor Charter and return with the charted evacuation line; Night Harbor Guild can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive undertow gate while evading the lighthouse revenant without sacrificing the charted evacuation line.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Night Harbor Guild to witness the living contour chart.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to publish an unsafe shortcut
